description: Temperature and humidity sensor with screen
exposes_summary: battery, temperature, humidity, comfort_temperature_min, comfort_temperature_max, comfort_humidity_min, comfort_humidity_max, temperature_units, temperature_calibration, humidity_calibration

exposes.name: Comfort temperature min
exposes.description: Minimum temperature that is considered comfortable. The device will display ❄️ when the temperature is lower than this value. Note: wake up the device by pressing the button on the back before changing this value..

exposes.name: Comfort temperature max
exposes.description: Maximum temperature that is considered comfortable. The device will display 🔥 when the temperature is higher than this value. Note: wake up the device by pressing the button on the back before changing this value..

exposes.name: Comfort humidity min
exposes.description: Minimum relative humidity that is considered comfortable. The device will display ☀️ when the humidity is lower than this value. Note: wake up the device by pressing the button on the back before changing this value..

exposes.name: Comfort humidity max
exposes.description: Maximum relative humidity that is considered comfortable. The device will display 💧 when the humidity is higher than this value. Note: wake up the device by pressing the button on the back before changing this value..

exposes.name: Temperature calibration
exposes.description: Offset to add/subtract to the reported temperature.

exposes.name: Humidity calibration
exposes.description: Offset to add/subtract to the reported relative humidity.
